title: Media and Communication
welcome_lead: Media shape what we know. From the press to social networks, communication is both topic and tool.
meta_desc: IBDP French: media, communication, and the role of journalism.
final_note: To read media in French is to read the world in French.

walkthroughs.body_html: Le Monde (centre-left), Le Figaro (centre-right), Liberation (left), Le Parisien (popular). Naming sources strengthens essays.
Useful: verifier les sources, croiser les informations, esprit critique. Cite phenomena: les fake news se propagent rapidement.
For 'les reseaux sociaux nuisent-ils a la democratie?', present pros and cons. Use il est indeniable que for emphasis.
